summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Nymox Pharmaceutical Corporation furnishing a press release that updates the status of its drug Nymozarfex (TM) for BPH. The update describes prior regulatory submissions and plans for re-submission in the US, subject to additional financing. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine business update of drug development progress. Therefore, it does not constitute a special situation event.
